definition: Vertical (image-y) displacement in mm of the centroid of the 4 undistorted tag corners after mapping through inverse of the per-stream reference tag-plane homography (plane = 20 mm square lb/rb/rt/lt; reference = per-stream median undistorted corners; DLT 4-point cv2.findHomography method=0); minus the stream median. Units mm in the tag plane.
evidence: Synthetic recovery within 1% at 20 deg tilt (S4b); 17 repo tests

definition: Unwrapped angle (rad) of the mean of the two 'horizontal' edge vectors (rb-lb)+(rt-lt) of the 4 rectified corners; minus stream median. In-plane rotation about the camera/tag normal.

np.nanstd(y) = population SD (ddof=0) about the stream MEAN of the full admitted series. No detrend, no band-limit, no outlier rejection. Includes all content up to ~30 Hz (camera Nyquist) plus measurement noise.
evidence: Recomputed from outputs/s4_pose_channels_by_frame.parquet: max abs diff 4.4e-16 (H1_y) and 9.9e-17 (H2) over all 61 streams; linear detrend would change RMS by 0-2.4% (min ratio 0.976)

definition: Least-squares sinusoid amplitude (not RMS) at best f within +/-0.05 Hz of 1.4318 Hz (Afh) or 3.0982 Hz (Afa); 21-point grid; mean-removed. s6 uses +/-0.08 Hz. Amplitude A corresponds to RMS A/sqrt2 only for a pure line.

detected (tag id 0 found) AND decision_margin>=30; sorted by frame_idx; no interpolation or gap fill; irregular header-derived stamps kept. Margin cut removes 0 frames (0 detected frames below 30; hamming=0 everywhere).
evidence: Recomputed from detections_ALL21.parquet: 115276 frames; 113852 valid; 111618 after dropping e20 cam1/cam2

definition: 60 admitted (e0-e19 x cam1-3) + e20_320rpm cam3 diagnostic-only; e20 cam1 (60.8% detected) and cam2 (61.3%) rejected and NOT computed in s4 (run_s4.py excludes e20 cam1/cam2).
evidence: s4_pose_by_stream.csv has 61 rows (20 cam1+20 cam2+21 cam3)

definition: timestamp_s = (record stamp - first record stamp)/1e9; mean dt 16.68 ms; dt range 10-27 ms (jitter); cam1/cam2 59.94 Hz and cam3 60.00 Hz nominal; ~30.5 s records (~1830 frames).

laser.stats: np.std(x, ddof=1) about mean, full band to 180 Hz, no detrend, 20 s record (7200 samples @360 Hz), channels in mm: heave_mm = centre head; pitch_rad=(side-centre)/(dside_cm*10) small-angle; bending_avg; torsion_proxy.
cam_bend = ((y1+y2)/2 + y3)/2 and cam_tors = y3 - (y1+y2)/2 of P1_y_mm on cam3 stamps (nearest within 0.75 dt); RMS=np.std. This is a camera COMBINATION, not per camera.
